entities.name: Al-Mu'izz ibn Badis
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Al-Muʿizz ibn Bādīs was the fourth ruler of the Zirids in Ifriqiya, reigning from 1016 to 1062. His regent was his paternal aunt Saïda bint Mansur until he reached majority.
